badgePage.title: Get Hi Cyou Badge
badgePage.subtitle: Display the Hi Cyou badge on your website to get a high-quality Dofollow backlink
badgePage.benefit1Desc: After adding the badge, your link on Hi Cyou will be upgraded to Dofollow, helping to improve your website's SEO weight and search engine ranking.
badgePage.benefit2Desc: Hi Cyou visitors can visit your website through the badge, bringing you more quality traffic.
badgePage.benefit3Desc: Displaying the Hi Cyou badge shows that your website has been reviewed, enhancing user trust.
badgePage.noBadgeWarning: Important: If you don't add the badge, your link will remain Nofollow and will not pass SEO weight.
badgePage.previewDesc: Choose a style that fits your website theme
badgePage.installDesc: Copy the code below and paste it anywhere on your website (footer recommended)
badgePage.codeCopied: Code copied to clipboard! You can now paste it into your website.
badgePage.step1Desc: Select a light or dark theme badge based on your website's color scheme.
badgePage.step2Desc: Click the Copy Code button to copy the HTML code to your clipboard.
badgePage.step3Desc: Paste the code into your website HTML, recommended in the footer area.
badgePage.step4Desc: We will verify and upgrade your link to Dofollow within 24 hours.
badgePage.faq1A: Dofollow links are links that pass SEO weight. Search engines track these links and include them in their ranking algorithms. In contrast, Nofollow links do not pass weight.
badgePage.faq2Q: Must the Badge be placed in the footer?
badgePage.faq2A: No, it's not mandatory. You can place the badge anywhere on the page, but we recommend the footer as it's the most common and user-friendly location.
badgePage.faq3Q: How long does it take to upgrade to Dofollow after adding the badge?
badgePage.faq3A: We will verify the badge on your website within 24 hours. Once verified, your link will be automatically upgraded to Dofollow.
badgePage.faq4A: Yes, but removing the badge will revert your link to Nofollow. If you want to maintain the SEO benefits of a Dofollow link, we recommend keeping the badge.
badgePage.faq5Q: Will the Badge affect website loading speed?
badgePage.faq5A: No. The badge is a lightweight SVG image (about 10KB) and will not significantly affect website performance.

backlinkDb.heading: One-Stop Backlink Resource Database
backlinkDb.introText: We have systematically organized scattered backlink opportunities:
backlinkDb.introItem1: Aggregated multiple websites/platforms for building backlinks
backlinkDb.introConclusion: Help you avoid pitfalls and focus your energy on truly valuable backlinks.
backlinkDb.faq1Q: 1. What is this backlink resource page for?
backlinkDb.faq1A_intro: This page organizes various websites and platforms where you can get backlinks, and marks:
backlinkDb.faq1A_item1Post: is supported (e.g., guest posting, account registration, directory submission, etc.)
backlinkDb.faq1A_conclusion: Convenient for you to quickly filter backlink opportunities suitable for your website, without having to search for scattered information everywhere.
backlinkDb.faq2Q: 2. What does DR in the table mean? Why is it important?
backlinkDb.faq2A_introPost: is a metric used by third-party tools (such as Ahrefs) to measure the overall backlink strength and authority of a domain. A higher value generally represents:
backlinkDb.faq2A_item1: The website itself has better backlink quality and quantity
backlinkDb.faq2A_item2: Backlinks obtained from this site usually have higher SEO value for your website
backlinkDb.faq2A_conclusionPre: Therefore, under the same conditions, you can prioritize websites with
backlinkDb.faq3Q: 3. What is the difference between Dofollow and Nofollow?
backlinkDb.faq3A_item1Post: : Search engines will track and pass some authority, which directly helps improve website authority and rankings.
backlinkDb.faq3A_item2Post: : Search engines usually do not pass authority, leaning more towards bringing brand exposure and direct traffic.
backlinkDb.faq3A_middle: Neither of these links is "useless", they just have different focuses:
backlinkDb.faq4Q: 4. Are these backlink platforms 100% safe? Will I be penalized?
backlinkDb.faq4A_introPre: The platforms we organize are mainly
backlinkDb.faq4A_introBold: normal sites and common backlink channels
backlinkDb.faq4A_item1: Search engines 100% like all forms of backlinks
backlinkDb.faq4A_item2: Massive, mechanical acquisition of backlinks from a certain type of site is safe
backlinkDb.faq4A_item3: Control the pace of backlink growth to avoid abnormal surges in the short term
backlinkDb.faq4A_item4: Maintain diversity of backlink sources (different types, different domains)
backlinkDb.faq4A_item5: Try to keep backlink content relevant to your website theme and valuable
backlinkDb.faq4A_conclusion: Ultimately, safety depends on your usage and overall SEO strategy.
backlinkDb.faq5Q: 5. Can these backlink platforms be indexed quickly?
backlinkDb.faq5A_intro: We cannot guarantee that all will be indexed, nor can we guarantee the indexing time. Influencing factors include:
backlinkDb.faq5A_item1: The crawl frequency and quality of the other website itself
backlinkDb.faq5A_item2: Your content quality (whether it is original and valuable)
backlinkDb.faq5A_item3: Relevance between websites, overall backlink layout, etc.
backlinkDb.faq5A_item4: Write valuable content, not just for the sake of placing links
backlinkDb.faq5A_item5: Try to keep the copy surrounding the backlink highly relevant to your website theme
backlinkDb.faq6Q: 6. Which backlinks should I start with?
backlinkDb.faq6A_intro: Generally, you can use the table according to this priority:
backlinkDb.faq6A_item3: Gradually expand to some high-quality Nofollow platforms to increase exposure and traffic
backlinkDb.faq6A_conclusion: If you have limited time, you can first use the filter function to keep only: "High DR + Dofollow + Self-Submission".
backlinkDb.faq7Q: 7. Is it necessary to do backlinks for small sites (low DR)?
backlinkDb.faq7A_intro: Yes. Although high DR websites are more "valuable", small site backlinks also have value:
backlinkDb.faq7A_item1: Can enrich your backlink source structure, making it look more natural
backlinkDb.faq7A_item2: Some vertical niche websites have low DR but are highly precise for your target audience
backlinkDb.faq7A_item3: Some small sites may grow into high-authority websites in the future
backlinkDb.faq7A_conclusion: Reasonable combination: High DR as "Core", Medium/Low DR as "Supplement".
backlinkDb.faq8Q: 8. How often will the information on the page be updated?
backlinkDb.faq8A_item2: Removing websites that are obviously invalid, inaccessible, or have major rule changes
backlinkDb.faq8A_item3: Appropriately adjusting DR information and notes
backlinkDb.faq8A_conclusion: If you find some links invalid or rules changed, you can also mark them or maintain your "private version" according to your situation.
